notes.title: LIVE NOW - God of Portals and Transitions Update
notes.notes:
The OB16 Update warps into SMITE 2 with style as Janus makes his grand return! This portal-popping powerhouse brings his iconic playstyle with powerful changes to his kit. He now stacks his passive twice, ignores magical protections to enemies Phased by Threshold, and his global ult can be fired mid-banish while falling from his Portal to set up some hype plays! Whether you're banishing foes or zipping through space-time, Janus is back and ready to transition his team to a win!

New Ported God

Janus

General

Ranged Basic Attacks

Damage Type: Magical

Scaling Type: Intelligence Scaling

Passive: Passages

When you pass through a Portal or Threshold, your next ability deals bonus Magical Damage.

Smite 2 +1’s

Now stacks up to 2 times.

Ability 1: Portal

Open a portal on a surface.

Wall portals create a passage to the other side for yourself

Ground portals Banishes you and enemies upwards, dealing Magical Damage to enemies on landing

Ability 2: Unstable Vortex

Launch two linked portals, dealing Magical Damage to enemies in their path.

Hitting an enemy with both portals deals bonus Magical Damage

Ability 3: Threshold

Unleash a rift that Slows enemies and grants Movement Speed to allies who cross it.

Slowed enemies are Phased, causing your abilities to deal bonus Magical Damage.

Passive: You and allies also gain stacking Movement Speed when crossing the rift or passing through a portal

Smite 2 +1’s

 Magical Damage Janus deals to Phased enemies ignore 25% of their Magical Protection

You are CC Immune while firing

Damage increases with distance traveled

Can now be used while falling from Portal, allowing you to exit the self banish early.

No longer has a maximum range at which it stops making new Portals.

notes.title: LIVE NOW - Defender of the Earth Update
notes.notes:
Get ready to ricochet into battle! Hou Yi, the Defender of the Earth, has landed in SMITE 2 with a sun-scorched vengeance! With wall-bouncing arrows, hybrid scaling, and celestial control through his Suntouched passive and dazzling ultimate Sunbreaker, Hou Yi brings a fiery twist to the battleground. Plus, his upcoming Aspect of the Mark lets basic attacks bounce between enemies just in time to light up the competition starting August 1!

This update also brings shifts to Conquest, dialing down objective damage while introducing new tweaks to farming and XP camps to promote more active play. Meanwhile, the long-awaited Healing Rework is here! Anti-heal is no longer item-bound, healing and lifesteal have been normalized, and a new wave of utility-focused items gives healing and sustain playstyles new tools to shine.

Open Betsa 15 is shaping up to be one of the biggest SMITE 2 updates yet! Hop on the Battleground and try out everything new!
New Ported God
Hou Yi

General

Ranged Basic Attacks

Damage Type: Physical

Scaling Type: Hybrid Scaling

After being Critically Hit or taking more than 20% of your Health in a single blow, become Suntouched. When you become Suntouched your active cooldowns are reduced and Mark the enemy who triggered this

While your Strength is higher than your Intelligence, Marked enemies take bonus Physical Damage based on their missing Health. While your Intelligence is higher than your Strength, Marked additional effects are amplified

Ricochet Stuns Marked enemies

Ricochet no longer bounces or stuns; it applies Mark of the Golden Crow on its first hit. If already marked, the mark spreads. Basic Attacks hitting marked targets bounce to a nearby enemy.

Conquest balance this patch is targeting some specific map issues. these are smaller changes as we're taking incremental steps to address feedback to get changes out sooner rather than later:

Too much safe farm

We want safe farm to exist in some form as a way to crawl back from a deficit, but we've seen the side camps turn into part of the regular farm rotation for sidelaners, which has encouraged passive playstyles, especially in Solo.

Healing Balance Update
High-Level Goals

Address Mandatory Anti-Heal:

New Player Trap: The current necessity of anti-heal is a common pitfall for new players who may not understand its importance. Heals sometimes being completely fight swinging or largely ineffectual also makes it difficult to identify the strengths specific gods bring to Smite.

Limited Build Variety at Higher Levels: Anti-heal items are often mandatory pickups for multiple gods in a match, taking up a slot that could be used for more interesting build opportunities.

Give “Healer” roles a more consistent presence

Healers will bring a more known quantity to team fights, which is useful for the healer, the person they are healing, and the enemy figuring out how to approach a fight. Jumping from 100% to 25% effectiveness based on being clipped by potentially any effect, can be difficult to track.

To help augment this, healing specific itemization should bring even further utility that healers exclusively will bring to team fights.

Give “Lifesteal” roles a more consistent presence

Similar to above, Anubis can sometimes swing to full health or feel like his gameplay doesn’t exist pretty quickly. We want gods that play with their health pool to be able to more reliably control the risks they want to take without making them unapproachable by enemies.

To help augment this, lifesteal specific itemization should bring even further utility that lifesteal exclusively will bring to team fights.

What We Are Removing

Anti-Heal from Items: We are eliminating anti-heal from items. This ensures it is not a required build component.

Reduced Lifesteal on Items: Lifesteal on all items will be reduced by approximately 25-50%, depending on the item.

All Healing Increases on Items: Items will no longer provide direct increases to healing output.

Reduced Item Healing: Healing derived from items will be reduced by approximately 30-60%, depending on the item's specific impact.

Reduced God Healing: God-specific healing will be reduced by approximately 30-60%, with the reduction amount dependent on the context of the god's heal:

Larger reductions apply to heals that are easy to trigger and are more defining for the god in question.

Ex. Aphrodite heal has no restriction on using it, is accessible due to its low cooldown, and is a major component of what she brings.

Ex. Baron Samedi’s Consign Spirits does require hitting an enemy god, but can apply to a full team. Its ‘base’ amount of healing was more reduced, while its conditional component of healing hurt targets was hit a bit less.

Lesser reductions apply to heals that are conditional and are more minor for the god in question.

Ex. Aspect Ra Ultimate is on a significant cooldown, so it didn’t receive as large of a reduction.

Ex. Most “Solo” Lane gods combat oriented sustain. Achilles’ Radiant Glory or Hua Mulan's Spear Thrust. These require more effort to trigger and put them more at risk, and tend not to have the same top end potential as true healers. 

Most healing is more heavily reduced towards higher levels and scaling. We don’t want to interfere too heavily with the laning phase which largely feels like it is in a good spot. 

Reduced God Anti-Healing:

All gods who apply Anti-heal will now apply it at 25% instead of 40%, and they will not stack.

What We Are Adding

New Lifesteal Items: Introducing new lifesteal items that offer beneficial effects for building lifesteal, without directly increasing healing output.

New Healing-Focused Items: Introducing new items that provide benefits for healing or healing abilities, without directly increasing healing output.

Adjusted Existing Items:

Brawler's and Contagion: These items have been adjusted to serve as "soft" counters to healing and lifesteal, respectively. We may increase the intensity of the soft counter and introduce a few more in the future.

Lernaean Bow and Divine Ruin: The stats for these items have been adjusted to be stronger, compensating for the removal of anti-heal.

Item Compensation for Nerfs: For items that experienced closer to a 50% nerf, we will endeavor to add an interesting new component rather than simply leaving them at half strength.

God Compensation for Nerfs: For gods that experienced closer to a 50% nerf to their healing, we will provide different utility in their kits to help compensate.

Gods Gaining Anti-Heal: Five gods will have anti-heal integrated as a core part of their kits to expand options when drafting against healer heavy compositions:

Agni (Noxious Fumes (1))

Ares (Searing Flesh (3))

Fenrir (Brutalize (3))

notes.title: OB14 July 16 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Another round of SMITE 2 bug fixes have hit the Battleground! Here's a list of everything that's been addressed.



Fixed an issue where you could not disable Auto Skill by choosing to manually level an ability

    NEW Quick Play Arena


        Quick Play is a new way to play SMITE 2, intended to provide faster, more action-packed matches    

        This queue will also be an experimental testing ground for bigger changes. Some aspects of Quick Play will evolve over time as we work to find what works best for players, and some things introduced in Quick Play may eventually graduate into other modes.    

        Initially, Quick Play Arena includes the following:        
                Roguelike Item Building                
                        Players are presented with a choice between three general playstyles at the start of each match                    

                        Then, each time they return to base with enough gold to purchase T3s, they are presented with a choice between three T3s that fit with that playstyle                    

                        Note: Players cannot access the Item Shop as they do in a traditional game of SMITE. They also cannot purchase T1 or T2 items.                    

                        This is intended to show the fun of building in a more accessible format, helping newer players to start having fun more quickly                    
            

                Dodge Button                
                        Players may make a quick dodge by pressing Shift on PC, or their Cancel button on Console (while a targeter is not up)                    

                        Melee Gods dodge farther than ranged Gods                    

                        A short movement speed buff is applied following a Dodge                    

                        Note: Players do not have Immunity while Dodging; this is a test of allowing more action and repositioning during fights, in a way that should be easy for players to read                    
            

                Faster Projectiles                
                        Ranged basic attack projectiles will travel slightly faster in this mode                    

                        This is roughly equivalent to the projectile speed increase granted by Griffonwing Earrings in SMITE 1                    
            

                Faster Pacing                
                        Changes to Gold, XP, and Tickets should lead to approximately 10 minute matches                    
            

                Action Cam 2.0                
                        A new, alternate camera position and aiming style which should feel much more familiar to fans of third-person shooters                    

                        In this camera perspective, your crosshairs are locked to the center of your screen; you will always shoot your basic attacks and abilities where you are looking                    

                        This does allow Ranged gods to shoot their basic attacks up or down; allowing this was needed for this camera style to feel natural. Note that Gods are still invulnerable during Leaps, even when using Action Cam 2.0.                    

                        Our internal testing shows that players more familiar with third-person shooters are more successful at hitting basic attacks with this style of camera, despite being able to theoretically miss shots by aiming too high or too low.                    

                        Note: Though we are listing this alongside the other Quick Play experiments, the new Action Cam can be used in any mode                    
            
    

        Currently, there is only a Quick Play Arena queue. Quick Play Joust and Quick Play Conquest will come at a later date

notes.title: LIVE NOW - God of Success Update
notes.notes:
Brace yourselves Deities, because Ganesha is charging onto the Battleground! This benevolent powerhouse brings blessings to allies and devastation to enemies with magical crowd control, protective auras, and his mighty Dharmic Pillars. Plus, his Aspect of the Triumphant is dropping June 20 for those looking to dish out some divine damage!

    The Wandering Market welcomes two new themed Travelers: the patriotic Freedom Traveler featuring Ra’Merica and Thorge Washington, and the magical Guan Unicorn Traveler including new whimsical Prisms for this fan favorite Classic Skin. And don’t forget to grab the Independence Day Supporter Store bundle to really show your red, white, and blue in style!

    Lastly, a TON of Quality of Life Improvements are hitting the Battleground to help streamline the new player experience. Whether you're a seasoned vet, or all new to the Battleground of the Gods, the Open Beta 12 - God of Success Update is the perfect time to hop into SMITE 2!
            

New Ported God
    

        Ganesha        
                General                
                        Melee Basic Attacks                    

                        Damage Type: Magical                    

                        Scaling Type: Intelligence Scaling                    
            

                Passive: Good Fortune                
                        Anytime you deal a killing blow, the nearest allied god receives the credit and you receive the rewards for an assist instead plus a bonus amount of gold. In addition, your assist range and the time before you lose assist credit is increased.                    
            

                Ability 1: Turn of Fate                
                        Send a curse forward dealing Magical Damage to enemies it passes through. For each enemy hit, all nearby allied gods gain Bonus Damage.                        
                                Enemy gods are marked for 5s. Any Hard Crowd Control effect consumes the mark to deal bonus Magical Damage.                            
                    
            

                Ability 2: Ohm                
                        Rise into the lotus position Silencing enemies in front of you and increasing Protections of nearby allied gods.                        
                                Ganesha gains an additional 50% of the protections he provides                            

                                You are Displacement Immune while channeling                            
                    
            

                Ability 3: Remove Obstacles                
                        Dash forward dealing Magical Damage to enemy minions you pass through stopping on enemy gods, holding them in place before Knocking them Up.                        
                                While Dashing you pass through ultimate player made walls and destroy non-ultimate player made walls.                            
                    
            

                Ultimate Ability: Dharmic Pillars                
                        Summon 4 Great Pillars to imprison your enemies. Enemies that pass the field between each pillar take an initial hit of Magical Damage, are Slowed, and have their Protections reduced.                        
                                Enemies continue to take Magical Damage if they stay in the field                            

                                Minions take 40% reduced damage from this ability                            
                    
            

                Aspect releasing June 20                
                        Aspect of the Triumphant                        
                                Ohm no longer silences but deals damage to enemies in front of you and provides yourself and allies Movement Speed. Turn of Fate’s mark now only procs the next time you hit the marked enemy with an ability. Additionally you no longer bestow kills to allies but each god kill provides permanent Cooldown Rate.                            
                    
            
    
New Wandering Market Travelers
    [img src="https://webcdn.hirezstudios.com/smite2-cdn/Thorge_Washington_Thor_1920_5acceb138a.jpg"]
    Freedom Traveler -  Prepare to witness liberty… unleashed! I cannot tell a lie… this Traveler slaps. Give me liberty, or give me an overhand thunder slam!

New Skins and Cosmetics

                Venom Strike Medusa, available in the Venom Strike Chest or Direct Purchase            
    

    [img src="https://webcdn.hirezstudios.com/smite2-cdn/Venom_Strike_Medusa_1920_6d52e047ed.jpg"]

        Prisms (purchasable for 100% Diamonds)

Quality of Life and New Player Improvements
    

        Graphical settings will automatically adjust for new PC players based on their system performance    

        Players will now auto-bypass the login screen if the servers are active; we saved you a click every time you log in!    

        Players’ last-played queue will now be remembered in online settings. If you last played Joust on PC and then go to play on Xbox, Joust should be the selected queue.    

        Added a button to Close the Settings menu    

        Several Match Lobby clean-ups have been made for better clarity:        
                Activate Boost is only visible in Assault            

                Change Role is only visible in Conquest            

                Role Tabs are only visible in Conquest            

                Owned Gods are always sorted to the top of the list            

                Added a button to close the filter tab            
    

        Aspects are disabled until a player reaches Account Level 5        
                Aspects are generally slightly more complicated or slightly more niche than a God’s core kit. We want to make sure players are a little more comfortable with SMITE before introducing the idea of Aspects.            
    

        Players will automatically Autobuild (including a Relic selection) until reaching Account Level 5        
                Similarly, forcing new players to click through selecting an Autobuild (or accidentally turning on Manual Build) and Relic was unnecessary complexity at this point in their learning journey.            
    

        Relic descriptions on the pre-game Relic Selection Screen have been simplified        
                This text is intended to help players quickly understand and decide which Relic to purchase. The full text is still available via tooltips.            
    

        Help Text should now be more obvious        
                The old color treatment was very easy for new players to miss            
    

        New Players will default to a new “Action Camera” perspective        
                We believe that new players will be better served by a camera with a narrower FOV, which makes targets in front of them appear bigger and allows combat to be easier to read            

                This should not affect current players, who may prefer the wider FOV currently used, which allows you to see more happening off to the sides at the expense of making things in front of you smaller            

                This is just the first test of this camera, and further changes may occur

notes.title: 🎸 The "God of Music Update" is Now Live!
notes.notes:
As promised in last Friday’s post, today’s patch has landed. Open Beta 10 is live on PC, bringing a new god and a wave of cosmetics to the game.

Apollo Arrives

The God of Music is ready to rock. Build Audacity with rapid basics, charm with Serenade, dash in with The Moves, then carry two teammates Across the Sky. His first cosmetic evolution, Aspect of Harmony, releases separately on May 23.

Land Shark Sobek Traveler Page

Purchase the Premium Traveler Page to unlock classic Land Shark Sobek instantly and earn three Prism variants (Orca Black, Goldfish Orange, Tubular Teal) plus the “Testing the Waters” jump-stamp and Deepbite badge. 

Mystic Guardian Athena Prisms

Starflare, Nightshade, Lunarveil and the bundle-exclusive Stardust are now available for Diamonds or in a discounted bundle, turning every shield wall into a light show. 

Jump in, claim your rewards, and check out all the balance changes in the Open Beta 10 Update Notes!  

See you on the Battleground!

Stalking the battlefield with her enhanced Marked for Death passive, Kali singles out foes, piercing their defenses and stealing vitality from her marked prey. notes.title: Titan Talk and Hotfix Roundup April 10th
notes.notes:
🔱 SMITE 2: Titan Talk Recap 
    Welcome to the official recap of the April 10th Titan Talk! This    week’s episode was hosted by Isiah and Killgoon, covering key updates,    hotfixes, developer insights, and community Q&A. Catch up on everything    you need to know as we march toward OB8 and beyond.
    ⚙️ Recent Hotfixes Recap
    We’ve had three hotfixes since OB7 shipped. Here’s a quick    summary of what’s been resolved:
    Monday Hotfix            
            Fixed shader precaching issue causing load-in freezes.        
                
            Fixed Merlin's ability not hitting the totem.        
                
            Fixed acquisition screen not closing.        
                
            Fixed God stats in the HU Editor.        
                
            Resolved the persistent ghost red dot in player profiles.        
       Tuesday Hotfix            
            Fixed gamepad issue preventing God lock-in on Xbox.        
                
            Addressed cursor loss in draft lobbies.        
                
            Resolved focus loss and coin purchase bug in Wandering Market.        
                
            Adjusted VGS for global emotes.        
                
            Fixed acquisition notifications in Wandering Market.        
       Wednesday Hotfix            
            Fixed Chaac’s ability not hitting stealth targets.        
                
            Corrected VO issues with Ra’s Oblivion Tier skin.        
                
            Resolved mastery progress showing as incorrect God.        
                
            Fixed pricing error for Hydra's Lament.        
                
            Fixed Wandering Market coin progress resetting on login.        
    
         Hotfixes will continue throughout OB7—keep reporting bugs and sending        feedback!    
    📅Looking Ahead: OB8 Preview            
            Kali Reveal Incoming – New god Kali drops in OB8!        
                
            Item Specialization Wave 1 – New items + major            balance shifts.        
                
            God Builder Feature (Beta) – Almost ready! Won’t            include autobuild at launch.        
                
            Possible Movement System Rework – Flash test is            live now after the show!        
        🎮 Community Questions & Dev Responses    🎮 Controller Vibration on Xbox            
            Still under investigation—some users report fixes after toggling            vibration settings or unplugging peripherals (like a mouse).        
                
            If you're affected, try toggling vibration OFF then ON again in            settings.        
         God Builder Update            
            God Builder is nearing completion and may launch in OB8.        
                
            Still missing polish and auto-build integration, but usable for            player testing and feedback.        
        No Skins Toggle            
            A “no skins” mode won’t be added.        
                
            Skins are a core monetization element and visual customization is            part of the appeal.        
                
            Clarity efforts continue (like God name display in combat and            pre-match screens).        
      Wind Sprites Feedback            
            Devs heard feedback around Wind Sprites being usable while            crippled—being reviewed.        
                
            Wind Sprites will persist longer after use to allow chases.        
                
            Sprite quantity on the map may be reduced for balance.        
       Prisms and Legacy Gems            
            Prisms currently require Diamonds.        
                
            No current plans to support Legacy Gems, but other unlock options            are being explored.        
        🎨 Cosmetics, Merch & Monetization    🧢 Cosmetics & Kill FX            
            Devs are exploring new cosmetics like kill effects            and potentially HUD skins down the line.        
                
            HUD skins were expensive in SMITE 1, but tech improvements in SMITE            2 may allow more options.        
        👕 Community Merch License            
            New licensing program allows players/artists to create and sell            SMITE merchandise using official IP.        
                
            Lifetime revenue cap applies before revenue sharing is required.        
                
            Launching TODAY after the show!        
        📈 Game Design & Balance   🛡 Community Meta Sentiment            
            Skepticism around OB7 is shifting positively post-launch.        
                
            Most players report the patch feels stable and fun.        
                
            Item changes and God performance are under continuous review.        
       Kali in Playtests            
            Kali is very strong in dev playtests—may receive            nerfs before release.        
                
            Strong synergy with new items in OB8 item pass.        
        Pele Update Success            
            Recent Pele adjustments received great feedback.        
                
            Devs aim to implement more targeted God reworks over time using            community feedback.        
        📦 Feature Requests & Player Feedback    🕹 Ability Ping System            
            Devs exploring ability cooldown pinging like ults.        
                
            Limited console VGS space complicates full implementation.        
       Match Requeue / Runback            
            No plans yet but devs like the idea and see value in it for positive            matchups.        
       Custom Crosshairs            
            More types may be added soon (e.g., dot, reticle, etc.).        
       Controller & Xbox Issues            
            Xbox crash reports and vibration issues are still being            investigated.        
                
            Bug report form and crash logs are critical for fixes—please fill            them out if you're affected.        
        Monetization & Referral Systems    🛍 Supporter Store + Wandering Market            
            OB7 launch and Supporter Store performance has been                            strong                        .        
                
            Combination of Supporter Store and Wandering Market boosted revenue            significantly.        
      Refer-a-Friend Program            
            Tech is being built, possibly by RallyHere.        
                
            No concrete system yet, but it’s in active development.        
        Free Currency Update            
            Wandering Market Coins = main free earnable currency.        
                
            No plans to add a new free currency at this time.        
         Movement Rework & Flash Test
    A new movement system is being tested now!
  Why It Matters:            
            Better synchronization between client/server movement.        
                
            Reduces “rubber banding” and improves responsiveness—especially on            high ping.        
                
            Based on Unreal Engine 5’s Saved Movement tech.        
      
         Try it now via the SMITE 2 Public Test Client on Steam! Feedback and        bug reports welcome in Discord.    
    🔮 Future Content Teases            
            Expect updates on new Gods,                            OB8 balance                        , and item adjustments next Monday.        
                
            New movement system flash tests happening this            week.        
                
            Devs are open to new Titan Talk formats and guest            appearances—share your ideas!        
    
    Thanks for reading, and thank you for supporting SMITE 2 as we continue    shaping the battleground of the gods!

notes.title: Titan Talk and Hotfix Roundup March 13th
notes.notes:
Did you miss Titan Talk yesterday! No worries, here is a summary!



   
Special Guest: Kellen
                                    
Audio Manager at Titan Forge, working on Smite for almost 11 years
                                        
Oversees and directs audio/music for the game
                                        
Collaborates with various departments to ensure seamless audio integration
                    
Kellen joined the show to discuss the ongoing work on Smite’s music and audio systems, along with the team’s approach to bug fixes and upcoming improvements.
Housekeeping & Recent Bug Fixes            
Hot Fixes Deployed:
        [olist]                            
Fixed an issue where minions dealt no damage to familiars or pets.
                                        
Further potential fix for the mini map overlay bug appearing in the store.
                                        
Resolved an issue with the Health Chalice not refilling on respawn if it had zero charges upon player death.
                                        
Fixed an audio bug causing the “ally has left the game” sound to play in post-match lobbies.
                                        
Restored music packs functionality in Assault mode.
                                        
Updated Aladdin’s lamp inventory behavior to prevent despawning other active items.
                                        
Fixed Zeus’s ultimate hit sound on his T5 (and base) skin so it now plays the correct effect.
                                        
Modified Bari’s Sacred Bell projectile and warning circle visuals to be more clear.
                    [/olist]                
Known Issues & Ongoing Work:
                                    
Pele’s Pyroclast Return: Investigating a bug with Pele’s pyroclast projectiles not returning properly.
                                        
Silent Wish Chest Ghost Rolls: Working on a fix for ghost roll issues—players will not lose any currency in the meantime.
                                        
Several other bug fixes mentioned by the dev team, including:
                                                            
Ymir Wall & Yemoja 3 incorrectly breaking Magi’s.
                                                                
Bari’s Mystic Surge incorrectly tracking minion/jungle camp kills.
                                                                
Match audio persisting into the end-of-match lobby.
                                                            Music & Audio in Smite 2
Music Packs Overview
New in Smite 2: Music packs have finally been introduced in Open Beta 5. These allow players to customize their in-game music, from the fountain-lobby intro track to epic kill streak pieces.
            
Why Music Packs?
                                    
Adds new layers of personalization and immersion.
                                        
Dynamic music triggers for taking down objectives, kills, and more.
                                        
A broad range of musical styles from calm lofi to heavy metal.
                        Top 10 Most-Equipped Music Packs (from Smite 1)[olist]            
Jetpack Fighter – Surprising #1 pick with an energetic, futuristic vibe.
                
Ruby (Licensed)
                
Slushy (Licensed)
                
Cyber Tokyo – Dark synthwave inspiration.
                
From the Nether – Spooky, ominous undertones.
                
Spirit Guide – Epic orchestral adventure feel.
                
Senpai – Anime-inspired, lively track.
                
Hellfire Syndicate – Metal-meets-hip-hop for a demonic/fashion vibe.
                
Heavenly Hymns – Ethereal and classic Smite orchestral.
                
Pirate – An adventurous pirate-themed rock mix.
    [/olist] 
Note: Some licensed packs cannot be carried forward into Smite 2.
Kellen’s Personal Favorites
Kellen, who oversees much of the audio direction, listed his top picks:
[olist]            
Worlds Collide – A unique fusion of lofi and metal elements.
                
Season of Souls – Dark and intense metal reminiscent of fast-paced action games.
                
Chibi Mech – High-energy and upbeat EDM/trance blend.
                
Sea Shanty – Features actual Hi-Rez employees singing a jaunty pirate tune.
                
Arcane Purity – Magical orchestral vibe ideal for a wizardly or mystical mood.
                
Divine Uprising – Classic, epic orchestral theme.
                
Bollywood – Vibrant, culturally-inspired track that’s a hidden gem.
                
Lo-Fi – Perfect for chill gaming sessions.
                
Prism of Soul – Epic, slightly tragic orchestral piece.
    [/olist]
Each pack was created by partnering with a range of composers, followed by feedback and iteration rounds. Some highlight collaborations have been done with producers like Andrea Bellucci, as well as artists from the metal band Hath.
Behind the Scenes: Audio DirectionHow Audio Themes Are Crafted            
Collaboration with God Designers: Kellen meets with design teams to understand a character’s abilities, tone, and needs.
                
Sound Palettes: Each god or theme receives a “sound palette” to set cohesive elements and textures across all abilities.
                
Iterative Development: Feedback is crucial—multiple revisions happen before finalizing a set of sounds.
                
Challenges: Avoiding overly literal sounds (e.g., barking bunnies) and ensuring variety among thematically similar gods.
    Dynamic Mixing & Future Audio Improvements            
Dynamic Mixing: Adjusts volume and intensity of different sounds (e.g. hits, global events) in real-time.
                
Potential Upcoming Tech: Expanding dynamic mixing for better hit feedback, better positional audio, and more.
                
Music Packs: Kellen teases an idea to create a possible “music pack playlist” system, letting players select and randomize segments from their owned packs.
    Working on Licensed Music & Projects            
Slipknot Collaboration: A huge highlight, culminating in exclusive Slipknot crossover packs & skins. Kellen recounts meeting the band and how important authenticity is in such high-profile partnerships.
                
Monster Cat & Other Collaborations: Deeper behind-the-scenes look at how new partnerships evolve and factor into Smite’s audio identity.
    Community Q&A Highlights            
Announcer Packs: The team is looking into bringing them to Smite 2. This includes the beloved Cthulhu and Lorelady versions, plus potential new ones.
                
Zeus T5 Audio Issue: Recently addressed so T5 Zeus’s ultimate & hit sounds now match the intended design.
                
DJ Skins Playing Music Together: Formerly a complicated system in Smite 1, but it may be easier in UE5. The team is investigating ways to bring back group-synced music.
                
Sun Wukong/Guan Yu Drums: Classic requests to restore old, iconic drum sounds and themes. It’s under consideration for the future.
                
Upcoming Gods & Audio Teaser: Next god’s name starts with an H — and yes, they have a voice.
    Key Dates & Events            
Pele Pyroclast Fix: Ongoing investigation to ensure return projectiles function properly.
                
Silent Wish Chest Issue: Being resolved so ghost rolls no longer occur.
                
Community Tournaments: Nika and Hazer are hosting the Smite 2 Euros. Catch the drafts and matches this week.
                
St. Patrick’s Day Event (Starting Friday): Complete matches to unlock the Celtic Music Pack for free.
    Final Takeaways            
Continuous Updates: The Smite 2 team is rapidly tackling bugs, performance improvements, and community feedback.
                
Ever-Evolving Audio: Music packs add flavor; new dynamic mixing systems are on the horizon, with Kellen constantly refining the in-game soundscape.
                
Stay Connected: More shows coming, including Monday’s “Merlin” reveal episode. Don’t miss the daily news on bug fixes, new features, and Q&A!

Welcome to another Titan Talk! We’re excited to share the latest news on SMITE 2, including the reveal of our newest Goddess and several important updates that just went live (or are coming soon). Here’s a quick breakdown:
1. New Goddess: Princess Bari
First Korean Pantheon God
Lore: Princess Bari was the unwanted seventh daughter who ultimately descended into the underworld to save her dying father. Despite being unappreciated, her selflessness and compassion led her to ascend into divinity.Theme & Aesthetics: Bari blends elements of Korean shamanic tradition—her signature bell staff, ceremonial fan, and distinctive wide-brimmed hat all reflect real-world Korean shamanism motifs.
Gameplay Role & Overview
Magical Carry or Mage: She deals magical damage but can flex into mid or duo.Unique Resource – SpiritBuilds from attacking gods or minions.Reaching 100 Spirit triggers a brief “Mystic Surge,” granting bonus stats and one enhanced cast of an ability.Abilities:[olist]Sacred Bell – Throws a bell projectile that can later be knocked around or pulled back to Bari, dealing damage (and eventually stunning when enhanced).Warding Gust – A fan-swipe in a cone. Knocks back enemies who are too close. Can also ricochet or empower the thrown bell.Reverent Steps – A freeform dance step dash that fires a projectile at the end; hitting an enemy god grants a burst of Spirit and reduces cooldown.Ultimate: Spirit’s CadenceSummons an area-of-effect dance that applies a short, “cheat-death” style protection to Bari and any allies who stand inside it.Instantly fills Bari’s Spirit to 100 and extends her “Mystic Surge,” giving her bonus attack speed, AoE basic attacks, and an enhanced ability cast.Protected allies who would drop to zero HP become briefly damage-immune (but silenced/disarmed). Executes still override this effect.[/olist]
Playstyle Tips
Combo Potential: Juggle the bells effectively for crowd control, wave clear, or burst damage.Team Fight Power: The Ultimate provides a lifesaving zone and re-empowers Bari for big plays.Build Paths: Lean into more “carry” style (Strength) for bigger basic attacks, or “mage” style (Intelligence) for heavy ability damage.2. Recent & Upcoming Game Updates
Awilix Release
Awilix is now live in SMITE 2, offering a Jaguar-riding assassin playstyle. Enjoy riding Suku into battle and more new plus-one abilities.
Frame Rate Options
PC players can now cap framerate at 90 or 144 FPS. More options could be added if there’s demand—give your feedback!
Double Worshiper Event
A minor technical delay meant the Double Worshiper Weekend started late. To compensate, the event is extended for an extra day so everyone can level up their new gods.
Minor Fixes & Hotfixes
Draft Lobby Display: An issue causing hidden team names in draft lobbies was fixed.Magi’s Cloak Bug: Coming soon (or already hotfixed) to fix random procs.Thor Aspect Changes: Some slow/cleanse tweaks and healing reductions are on the way.
New Item: Erendite
Returning as an active item featuring a stealth-reveal ability (think a “sonar ping” effect).Successful reveals grant bonus damage and movement speed for a chase.Perfect for countering invisible gods like Loki or Izanami.
HUD Editor (PC Beta)
A long-awaited feature is here: you can now move and resize HUD elements freely on PC.Console support planned for a future update once the PC version is polished.
Music Packs
60+ classic music themes from past events, passes, and more are returning in a Music Chest.Use your Legacy Gems to roll for these nostalgic themes (excluding licensed tracks).
Conquest & Other Balance Tweaks
Refinements to Conquest map visuals near towers.Further Aspect adjustments are in development—stay tuned for official patch notes.3. What’s NextFlash Testing: Princess Bari and these newest changes should be available in Flash Testing very soon. Jump in, try them out, and leave feedback.Keep the Feedback Coming: Let us know on the official forums, social channels, and in-game bug reports what you think about Bari, Erendite, HUD Editor, and more.Stay Tuned for More Gods: We’re continuing to refine and update existing characters, plus new additions are always in the works!

notes.title: Titan Talks and Hotfix Roundup March 1st
notes.notes:
Technical Updates & Hotfixes
Hotfixes That Went Live

Double Worshippers Event: Talked about an issue affecting the event but this has been resolved. 

Recent Bug Fixes

Assault Bench Issue: Resolved a problem where initial picks were getting incorrectly added to the bench.

Auto Build Upgrades: Starter item upgrades now functioning as intended.

Spirit of Desolation / Jotun’s Revenge: Will no longer proc on clones.

Prophetic Cloak Reactivation: Prophetic Cloak was turned back on after the devs ironed out some unexpected behaviors.

Typhon’s Fang Disabled: Temporarily removed because buying and selling it retained its passive permanently. A fix is on the way.
God Release Roadmap
Overview

The SMITE 2 team is moving toward a new God release schedule: one God every two weeks rather than every week. This begins with the next new God, Princess Bari, on March 10.

Additional Weekly Content: Though God releases switch to bi-weekly, there will still be new aspects, items, and other exciting gameplay content every week.

The new schedule: five classic Gods followed by an all-new God, ensuring a steady stream of beloved favorites and fresh faces.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44832142/a7487e0bc9ba3a3822f4d0d9ac4dbb41df896b66.png
Upcoming God Dates (Subject to Change)
[olist]
Princess Bari – March 10 (OB 5)

Merlin – March 24 (OB 6)

Cerberus – April 7

Kali – April 21

Guan Yu – May 5

Apollo – May 19

New God (H) – June 2
[/olist]
Why the Change?

Quality & Pace: The dev team wants to ensure each God has the level of polish and testing required for a stellar release.

Production Realities: After recent team restructuring, it’s important to maintain a sustainable production cadence.

Community Feedback: Many players requested more time to adapt to each new God, so this schedule supports that.
Art Deep Dive: Upcoming Gods
Art Director Ben walked through the unique challenges of bringing each God into SMITE 2’s upgraded engine:
1. Princess Bari
Pantheon: The first Korean deity in SMITE 2, inspired by Korean shamanistic tradition.

Design Elements:

Traditional garb (including a culturally-accurate tall hat) and bright pops of color.

Elaborate bells that tie into her in-game abilities.

Ben’s Notes:

The team did in-depth cultural research and collaborated with Korean staff to ensure authenticity.

Vibrant materials show off SMITE 2’s new rendering capabilities.
2. Merlin
Release Date: March 24

Famous for: Multi-stance magic (Arcane, Fire, Ice).

Art Challenges:

Essentially three separate effects sets for each stance, making it a more complex project.

Cloth materials and magical accents are enhanced with next-gen PBR (Physically Based Rendering) materials.

Ben’s Notes:

The original Merlin design was well-received in SMITE 1, so the focus is on polishing visuals and materials.

Effects teams are creating stand-out animations for each elemental stance.
3. Cerberus
Release Date: April 7

Key Feature: Three-headed design requires specialized rigging.

Art Upgrades:

Adjusted the snout/head ratio to feel more dog-like and balanced.

Upgraded materials for more realistic and menacing texture details.

Ben’s Notes:

Each head moves independently, which increases animation complexity.

Cerberus has unique rigging to handle multi-head behaviors.
4. Kali
Release Date: April 21

Notable Update: Received a bigger visual overhaul compared to her SMITE 1 design.

Art Changes:

No more high-heeled armor; a more culturally resonant mid-ground between classic and modern styles.

Added a skull garland to highlight her lore roots.

Ben’s Notes:

The team aims to respect the spirit of Kali’s mythology while balancing modernization.

Extra arms, new cloth physics, and potential future touches (like a signature tongue cameo) are under consideration.
5. Guan Yu
Release Date: May 5

Core Theme: Legendary Chinese general vibe intact, with signature armor and horse.

Visual Tweaks:

Updates to his horse’s proportions (less “buff,” more realistic form).

Polished materials to capture the PBR advantages.

Ben’s Notes:

No major design overhaul; Guan Yu’s stylized look is iconic.

Might subtly adjust proportions (hand size, etc.) if tech allows.
6. Apollo
Release Date: May 19

Rework Approach: Largely retains his known SMITE 1 revamp, upgraded with SMITE 2’s advanced materials.

Ben’s Notes:

Key goal is to emphasize his golden details and skin rendering.

Adding subtle finishing touches to ensure cloth, gold, and hair all shine.
7. Mystery “H” God
Release Date: June 2

All-New God: Expect fresh lore, visuals, and kit design. More details soon!
Q&A Highlights
During the show, Kilgoon and Ben fielded community questions on art, design philosophies, and future content:
[olist]
Why Bi-Weekly God Releases?

Quality control is the main focus. The SMITE 2 team wants every God to feel polished and well-tested.

Collaboration Skins:

Potential crossover skins are still on the table for the future, but the team is balancing new productions with community priorities.

Revamping Older Designs:

The devs aim to maintain each God’s iconic identity while applying a next-gen art pass to materials, lighting, and proportions.

Community Concept Submissions:

The team loves seeing fan-made concepts. If the community responds well, there’s a chance those ideas can become official.

Art & Lore Balance:

While the team respects the pantheons and their lore, practical gameplay needs can shift certain design elements.

Ultimately, the goal is fun, with a nod to authenticity whenever possible.
[/olist]Closing Thoughts
SMITE 2 continues to evolve and refine its gods, giving both veterans and newcomers something to be excited about.

Community Feedback: The devs are actively reading and incorporating suggestions, so keep sharing your thoughts.

Upcoming Streams: Look out for more Titan Talks and dev shows where they’ll dive deeper into Princess Bari’s kit, new feature reveals, and eSports updates.

Stay tuned for more Titan Talk episodes as SMITE 2 marches forward with a new content schedule, improved visuals, and community-driven improvements!

Thank you for reading, and we’ll see you on the Battleground of the Gods! Remember to follow our official channels for the latest news and patch updates:

notes.title: SMITE 2 Titan Talks and Hotfix Roundup February 22nd
notes.notes:
Here is a quick recap from anything you missed yesterday! 

 Titan Talks February 21st

 Why Release OB4 on a Monday?Avoiding Weekend Hotfixes: The dev team prefers early-week launches to ensure they’re fully staffed and ready to address any immediate post-patch issues. Launching late in the week risks weekend problems—and weekend work for the team.Watch Socials for Timing: While 7:00 AM Eastern was the targeted downtime, final live times vary. Once servers are updated, official channels will announce when OB4 is truly playable. New God & Aspect StrategyArtemis’s Aspect Arrives ImmediatelyThe team noted it’s interesting to see players get used to a god’s base kit before introducing a transformative Aspect. Despite launching Artemis’s Aspect right away this time, expect future gods to release their Aspects later to allow players more time on the base kit first.Awilix’s Visual & Kit ApproachDevs wanted to preserve her fluid “flow-state” playstyle, adding only small tweaks (e. g., synergy with Suku). Feedback from early tests suggested any drastic revamp would break her core feel. Hence, her OB4 design changes focus on thematic flourish rather than a big mechanical shift. Face Model Updates & Art ConsistencyCommunity Feedback: Achilles, Aphrodite, and Poseidon (Phantom Seas) got revised face/rigging to closer match their card art.Intent: Card art and in-game models should align more faithfully, so the team is constantly fine-tuning lighting, rigging, and facial geometry based on feedback. Assault “Team Bench” & Reroll PhilosophyAddressing “I Wanted That God!”Players have long been frustrated when a teammate rerolls a god they actually wanted. Now, once rerolled, that “discarded” god goes to a shared “Team Bench.” Anyone can pick it up, keeping the random fun alive but reducing lost opportunities.Maintaining Random SpiritDevs don’t want Assault to become a free-choice mode. Healers are still limited, and only rerolled gods appear on the bench. They’ll watch how this new system affects team comps and match pacing. Conquest Changes: The Bigger PictureEncouraging Early AggressionThe team noticed that farming could feel strictly better than fighting early. XP from kills is now more rewarding, making early ganks and aggression a viable path to victory.Diminishing Returns on BullyingWhen a high-level player repeatedly kills a much lower-level player, the XP gained is noticeably reduced. The goal is to avoid the “snowball effect” of hammering an under-leveled opponent for the same big reward.Doors, Minotaurs & Base SiegesRunic Bomb can now destroy enemy base doors; minotaurs remain strong tools for closing out the game. The devs hope these tweaks encourage more dynamic endgame pushes and coordinate objective-based play. UI & Quality of Life: Rationale Behind the UpdatesScoreboard Ability DetailsNewer players struggled to understand an enemy’s abilities after dying. Being able to hover or select an enemy god’s portrait to read their kit helps reduce confusion and fosters better counterplay.God Page RefinementsMulti-stance gods can toggle through stance abilities directly in the god page. This was highly requested in Titan Talk sessions for clarity and practice outside of live matches.Jump Stamp VisibilityPreviously, jump stamps were visible through Fog of War—effectively a “pay-to-lose” mechanic if you had a flashy stamp. Now, they’re hidden unless you have direct line of sight.Dev Team Perspectives on Balance Tweaks
Rather than repeat the changes:
Penetration & Burst:The devs emphasized that too many high-penetration items at once create lethal “burst-heavy” scenarios. OB4 reduces some penetration values to see if it mitigates that “instant-delete” feel.Healing & Anti-Heal:The community and top players alike voiced concerns about the power of healing comps. Developers are carefully buffing anti-heal durations so players can maintain pressure longer without removing healing from the game entirely.Warrior/Guardian Tuning:Addressing underused items like Warrior’s Axe aligns with the devs’ broader goal: give different roles more item paths. The team wants players to discover a variety of valid build routes, not just “cookie cutter” ones. Community-Driven Questions & Future Plans
Here are a few behind-the-scenes bits not spelled out in patch notes:
Why Are Some Features Not in Yet?God Builders, Bracket Targeting, and HUD Customization require major engineering and UI time. The devs confirm these are in active development but come after core systems are stabilized.FPS Caps & Optimization120 FPS on all platforms remains a desired milestone; the devs need further optimization to ensure stable performance. They’re also looking at adding more in-between caps (e. g., 144 or custom caps) for different monitors.Stylistic ApproachThe team is aiming for a “painterly” or “stylized” look that feels uniquely SMITE—rather than ultra-realism. Early on, feedback suggested the game was veering too realistic. Hence, the color palette and lighting are intentionally more vibrant and stylized.Releasing Some Aspects LaterYou’ll notice not all newly ported gods launch with an Aspect. This is to let the community fully explore the base kit first. Artemis is a special case this patch, but expect more “post-release Aspects” going forward.Social/Party System WorkKnown invite/party formation bugs remain a major target. A dedicated sub-team is tackling these issues, and we’ll see incremental fixes rolling out in upcoming patches.Feedback: The Engine That Drives IterationThe devs reiterated how crucial community insight is for refining game flow:Tournament POVs & Creator Feedback: Big influences on tuning gods, from minor kit adjustments to broader item reworks.Ambassador Conversations: The internal community panels often bubble up issues (e. g., certain starts or items underperforming).Expect more incremental changes to gold bounties, new item additions, and further assault/conquest tweaks based on real-world data. Looking AheadOB4 hits very soon, with Artemis and her Aspect, plus many behind-the-scenes improvements.Awilix arrives next week—on track for March 3, unless scheduling shifts.Future dev talk topics: new Aspects (Baron Samedi is on deck), ongoing UI improvements, quality-of-life expansions (music packs, more party fixes), and continued game-mode polish.Stay ConnectedFor exact downtime or hotfix times, always check official SMITE 2 socials.If you haven’t already, dive into the OB4 Patch Notes for every detail on item/god changes.Keep the feedback coming—through Titan Talk, official forums, and community channels. Your voice shapes the battleground.
Thanks for reading, and we’ll see you Monday in OB4!

notes.title: SMITE 2 Goes Free-to-Play With Big Changes and New Gods
notes.notes:
I have to give a lot of credit to SMITE 2 and by extension the original SMITE for actually interesting me in the MOBA genre. I never really got into the scene due in large part to an exchange I had with a friend when League of Legends was exploding in popularity. He said to me that I should play it, but just to be ready to be yelled at constantly for not being good. I decided not to play it.



But I actually quite enjoyed SMITE the handful of times I dipped into it. Its tactical style of gameplay combined with a more action-focused camera made it feel a lot smoother and more approachable to get into, and I found myself having a lot more fun than the few times I actually did try to play League of Legends. CGM was fortunate to sit down with Hi-Rez Studios to get some pretty big news about SMITE 2, and it was really impressive to see. 






We got to speak with Design Director AJ Walker and Advanced Game Designer Daniel Cooper, who had some big announcements for SMITE 2. Most... Read more

 Silences now interrupt prefires, meaning you are unable to buffer into a Silence.

notes.title: Closed Alpha 4 - 10/22/24 Patch
notes.notes:
New Early Surrender Functionality

Implemented Early Surrender functionality to match SMITE 1 for All Modes

 Teams can surrender at 3m into the match if a teammate has DC'd before that time

Implemented Early Surrender Ranked SR functionality to match SMITE 1 for protecting SR

 For all Ranked Modes, if an early surrender occurs, the following will happen (this will ONLY occur if a team successfully surrenders before 10m).
 Active players on the losing team will lose 0 SR.
 The disconnected player will lose 2x the full SR amount they would have lost if the match finished normally.
 The enemy winning team will win 0.5x the full SR amount they would have lost if the match finished normally.


Server Side Bug Fixes - Live Now


 Fixed an issue where a team could double pick the same God


Client Side Bug Fixes - Releasing on PC later tonight and on Console tomorrow


 Fixed the camera being stuck overhead after using base portal
 Fixed Bellona weapons not appearing in her hand after using base portal
 Fixed targeters being offset after using base portal
 Fixed HUD navigation not being able to close on gamepad (this fix was attempted in an earlier Patch, but was not successful)
 Reverted nameplate changes back to CA3 configurations

notes.title: LIVE NOW: The Closed Alpha 2 Update
notes.notes:
Hello Divine Deities, and welcome to SMITE 2's second Closed Alpha Update!

[previewyoutube=Hx1ysc1kyn8;full][/previewyoutube]

The team has been hard at work for the past 3 weeks, and we are excited to get everybody into Closed Alpha 2! We have fixed bugs, made Quality of Life improvements, added 2 new Gods, and much more. For a list of the full changes, head over to the Closed Alpha 2 Update Notes on the SMITE 2 Website.

For a basic overview, here are some of the highlights!

General Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the Arena mode was not granting the correct amount of worshipers
 Fixed an issue where players could get deserter when other players exited a Ranked match
 Fixed an issue where the Mastery Level 9 required more worshipers to attain than Mastery Level 10
 Arrows for those sensitivity settings allow you now to click and hold to cycle fast
 Dashes, Leaps, and other movement abilities have been improved to allow you to end the tween moving at max speed in any direction you want

Art Updates

 Sol and Ymir Card Arts reworked to show more of the artwork
 Jing Wei card art has been adjusted due to player feedback
 Hades’ staff has been reworked to a 2 pronged bident
 Updated CC buff bar icon art to a new consistent set of symbols that match those used in ability tooltips

UI Updates

 Fixed a variety of issues where Settings would reset at unintended times
 Gods Page now has arrows in the top left to allow cycling between gods without backing up to the full list
 Items in your inventory that are ready to be upgraded will now display a gold coin icon on them
 Fixed an issue where the Profile Page level bar was not matching the players actual level

New Player Tutorial

 A basic combat tutorial can now be played through a unique queue
 This is intended to convey the most basic concepts of the game, and more features will be implemented in the future to help players grow their skills over time as they learn the nuances of SMITE 2.

Role Preference System

 The role preference system has been reworked for SMITE 2.
 Before queueing for a Conquest match, players will now order their preferred roles from 1 (most preferred) to 5 (least preferred), and roles for a team will be assigned based on these preferences
 If a player does not receive one of their top 2 roles, they will be granted priority on role assignment for their next match. The amount of priority granted scales from “Priority” to “High Priority” based on a few factors.


Beyond the above, we have made changes to the Ranked Queues and Matchmaking System, fixed over 30 known bugs.

As always, we are excited to hear your feedback on these changes! We plan to continue working side-by-side with the Community to make the SMITE 2 experience the best it has ever been.

See you in the Battleground Deities!

notes.title: Smite 2 1.0 release date estimate, gameplay, progress transfer, and latest news
notes.notes:
When is the Smite 2 1.0 release date? Following some confusion around the Smite sequel thanks to a closed alpha period in May 2024 and an incorrect release date on Steam, the official free-to-play release date is now here, sort of.
As one of the greatest MOBA games of all time, Smite gives you a choice of over 100 legendary Gods to pilot in a colorful and chaotic arena battle. Smite 2 takes this one step further, keeping the beloved gameplay and characters of the first game and adding improved graphics, animations, and more. If you're still not convinced there's room for a Smite 2 at all, see what we thought of the sequel in our Smite 2 preview. If you don't need selling on the sequel, read on to find out more about the Smite 2 release date.
